decisions.reason: As a core sports-flooring system with visible launch investment, management can attribute any weak uptake to delayed sports-hall projects and will tend to persist.
This mobile arena floor likely absorbed meaningful development and marketing resources, and poor recent demand can still be explained as a temporary shock rather than a failed concept.
Its overlap with another mobile arena system raises the chance of rationalization, but sunk costs and public commitment still make continuation slightly more likely than withdrawal.
Because it was important enough to be featured on the home page and fits the firm's wood-flooring capabilities, management is likely to defend the launch and keep it available.
As a niche but complementary sports-floor finish, it supports the specialist portfolio and is likely to be retained rather than treated as an admitted mistake.
This accessory is inexpensive to carry, complements the sports-floor systems, and is therefore the easiest product for management to keep in place.
